overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong academic and professional social media presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon, totaling 3,580 followers. His content consistently focuses on computational social science, coordinated inauthentic behavior, tool releases (CooRnet), and research team hiring, driving high engagement relative to audience size across all three channels.

contentThemes.description: Announcements of new papers, research grants, and study findings related to information operations and coordinated behavior.
Updates regarding software tools like CooRnet v2.0 for detecting coordinated link sharing.
Hiring posts for postdoctoral researchers and research opportunities for PhD students.
Promoting upcoming conference talks (#DisinfoConf2025) and reflections on multi-platform research methods.

recommendations: Cross-promote major research milestones and hiring notices on all platforms, as job/opportunity posts drive high viral sharing on Bluesky and interaction on LinkedIn.
Increase visual media usage (e.g., charts, tool screenshots, paper cover pages) to boost engagement rates further.
Engage actively in comments on Mastodon and Bluesky to convert higher repost rates into community discussions.

platformInsights.bluesky: Highest engagement rate per follower (6.14% avg ER), driven by high repost/amplification rates on paper publications and student opportunity calls.
platformInsights.mastodon: Provides steady, targeted engagement from an academic niche audience (aoir.social), performing best when sharing tangible tool releases like CooRnet.
platformInsights.linkedin: Largest follower base (1,850 followers) generating the highest raw numbers of likes and comments, particularly effective for professional grant announcements and recruitment.
